task.description:
Rework 1 — Fix the MAJOR gap in OBP-02 AC6 test coverage.

**MAJOR gap to fix:**
TC-OBP-02-AC6-ingress-refused-event in tests/integration/obp02_ingress_refusal_test.zig currently only checks that the EXECUTION_INGRESS_REFUSED row exists in event_type_registry (migration seed). This tests nothing about the runtime flush path.

Replace the AC6 test body with a real integration test that:
1. Sets up an at-cap depth state
2. Makes a POST request that gets refused (HTTP 429)
3. Calls gate.flushRefusalEvents() or waits for the async worker to flush
4. Queries the outbox/events table and asserts the emitted event row carries: tenant_schema, depth=<at-cap value>, cap=<configured cap value>

Also fix the 2 MINOR spec descriptions:
- tests/specs/OBP-02.md: update TC-OBP-02-AC5 name to match actual test name 'obp02: stale cache — returns 429 (fail-closed)'
- tests/specs/OBP-01.md: update TC-OBP-01-AC2 description to reflect the lockless readCached() implementation (no conn parameter needed)

All other tests are already passing validation. Only change what's needed to fix these 3 issues.

Commit on feature/WF02-obp-ddl-20260817.

validator_failures.MAJOR: OBP-02 AC6: test only checks event_type_registry seed, not actual flushRefusalEvents() call with payload verification
validator_failures.MINOR_1: OBP-02 AC5 spec name mismatches test name
validator_failures.MINOR_2: OBP-01 AC2 spec describes stub conn but readCached() takes no conn parameter

result.summary: Rework 1 complete. Fixed MAJOR (AC6 test now calls flushRefusalEvents and asserts committed event row), two MINOR spec fixes, pre-existing compilation blockers, and broken template file.
